title: Quoted material — Example 2 (indented set-out quotation)

illustrates.quote: Example 2: A set-out quoted passage can be indented by 4 cells, so that new paragraphs within the quote start in cell 7, and runovers begin in cell 5. (Overall typeform indicators are not necessary.)

blocks.text: Example 2: A set-out quoted passage can be indented by 4 cells, so that new paragraphs within the quote start in cell 7, and runovers begin in cell 5. (Overall typeform indicators are not necessary.)

print.notes: As with Example 1 (b004-g-1.json), this is generic descriptive guidance (a margin/indent recipe: quote indented 4 cells, its own paragraphs at cell 7, runovers at cell 5) with no actual quoted passage shown in print and nothing rendered into braille. resolution: A and B agreed completely that this item is prose-only, with no print excerpt or braille anywhere in the source (both independently confirmed against B004.txt lines 726-729 and the PDF page image, p.24).
